{"status":"available","text":"本文的核心贡献类型是 benchmark（评测基准）而非新模型，因此其“方法”对应的是 Video-MME 的构建流程与评测协议本身：任务是系统评估 MLLM 在视频分析上的能力，输入是采自 YouTube 的原始视频及其附属信息，最终输出是一套带高质量人工标注的 video QA 数据与可复现的评测流程 (E002, E008)。

构建分三步：video collection、question-answer annotation 与 quality review (E036)。

Video Collection。先建立 domain hierarchy 作为采集骨架，再从 YouTube 获取原始视频。共设 6 个主域，即 Knowledge、Film & Television、Sports Competition、Life Record、Multilingual，每个域再细分为具体 tag（如 Sports Competition 下的 football、basketball），合计 30 个细粒度类别；每个类别都收集短（<2 分钟）、中（4–15 分钟）、长（30–60 分钟）三档时长的视频，并同时抓取字幕（若有）与音频等 meta-information，以便后续考察外部模态信息的作用。最终得到 900 个视频，其中 744 个带字幕、900 个带音频 (E037, E045)。

Question-Answer Annotation。在原始视频之上标注 QA，用以严格考察 MLLM 对视频内容的理解。形式上采用 multiple-choice QA，以便直接、灵活的评测；标注者需具备较强的英语能力与 vision-language learning 研究经验。具体做法是每位标注者完整观看视频后迭代撰写 3 道相关问题，每题配 4 个候选选项，最终形成 2,700 个 QA pair。这些问题覆盖 12 种 task type，横跨 perception、reasoning 与 information synthesis，并且被设计为必须紧扣视频内容，使模型无法在不参考视频的情况下答对 (E038, E039, E040)。

Quality Review。为保证质量，每道 QA 先交由另一位标注者复核，检查语言表达是否清晰准确、问题是否可答、候选选项是否逻辑自洽、指定正确答案是否恰当。此外，为剔除仅凭语言先验即可解出的样本，把纯文本形式的问题单独交给 Gemini 1.5 Pro，过滤掉不看视频也能答对的 QA，并将不合格题退回原作者修改；例如可由常识直接推出答案的题目会在这一阶段被排除。统计显示 Gemini 1.5 Pro 在纯文本设定下准确率不足 15%，说明该步骤确实筛掉了不需要视频线索的题目 (E041, E042)。

与难度刻画相关的统计（属于数据构建的一部分）。数据集包含 900 个视频、744 份字幕与 900 个音频文件 (E045)。QA 各文本字段的字数在不同时长下保持稳定（问题约 11.5–14.5 词），而字幕词数随时长明显增长，短、中、长视频平均分别约 198.6、1425.6、6515.6 词，说明长视频承载的信息量更大 (E046, E052)。正确选项 A/B/C/D 的分布接近均匀（25.1/27.2/25.3/22.4%），以避免位置偏置 (E059)。论文借鉴 EgoSchema 的 certificate length 度量 QA 的时间难度：certificate 指足以让人类验证者确信该标注正确的最小 sub-clip 集合，certificate length 即这些子片段时长之和；每类随机抽 3 个视频统计，短、中、长视频的中位 certificate length 分别为 26s、164.7s 与 890.7s (E060, E061)。基准还按时长切分为 Video-MME-S/M/L 三个子集，各含 300 个视频与 900 个 QA (E016, E018)。

评测协议（4.1 Settings 与第 7 节）。受评模型共 16 个：4 个 commercial models 与 9 个代表性 open-source video MLLM，另加 3 个 advanced image MLLM 以检验基准对 multi-image 场景的适配性 (E083, E100)。其中 commercial models 为 GPT-4V、GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Flash 与 Gemini 1.5 Pro (E101)；open-source video MLLM 包括 Video-LLaVA、ST-LLM、ShareGPT4Video、VideoChat2-Mistral、VILA-1.5、Chat-UniVi-V1.5、VITA-1.0、VITA-1.5 与 LLaVA-NeXT-Video (E102)；advanced image MLLM 为 Qwen-VL-Chat/Max 与 InternVL-Chat-V1.5 (E103)。

视频统一转为多帧图像输入。对支持极长多模态上下文的 Gemini 1.5 Pro，短、中视频按 1 frame per second 采样，长视频按每 2 秒 1 帧采样以保证 API 稳定；其余模型遵循各自官方配置均匀采样固定帧数，例如 GPT-4V 取 10 帧、GPT-4o 取 384 帧，并尽量多取帧以充分释放其能力 (E104, E086)。启用字幕时，只取与所采帧时间戳对应的字幕——若采样 10 帧，就取这 10 个时间点各自的字幕，从而保证视觉与文本输入在时间上对齐、语义连贯 (E105, E080)。

推理与打分的输入组织为“complete video frames + complete subtitles/audios（可选）+ question with prompt”：模型若有默认的 multiple-choice prompt 则沿用默认，否则使用统一 prompt，并要求只输出选项字母 (E106, E107)。准确率由正则表达式抽取模型输出后直接与 ground-truth 答案比对，不借助 ChatGPT 等外部评判模型 (E108, E095)。评测在三种输入模态条件下展开，即 frames only、frames with subtitles 与 frames with audio，以便分离不同模态信息对视频理解的作用 (E092, E094)。","sources":["E002","E008","E016","E018","E036","E037","E038","E039","E040","E041","E042","E045","E046","E052","E059","E060","E061","E080","E083","E086","E092","E094","E095","E100","E101","E102","E103","E104","E105","E106","E107","E108"]}

The user wants a method section narrative in Chinese for Video-MME, a benchmark paper. Core contribution type: benchmark/evaluation. So method = dataset construction + evaluation protocol (that's the core method). Should include: video collection, QA annotation, quality review, statistics (maybe brief), evaluation settings and protocol. But instruction says downstream evaluation result lists, benchmark metrics and results should go to experiment section; only mention briefly when needed. However for a benchmark paper, construction and evaluation protocol are core method. So include evaluation protocol (settings, frame extraction, subtitle utilization, evaluation format, accuracy computation) — that's protocol, part of method for benchmark papers. Avoid listing all results (accuracies).

Let me write 900–1600 Chinese characters.

Key content:
- Task: build first full-spectrum MLLM evaluation benchmark for video analysis. Input: raw videos from YouTube; output: 900 videos, 2,700 multiple-choice QA pairs, subtitles/audio.
- Core contribution type: benchmark/dataset + evaluation protocol.
- Construction three steps: video collection, QA annotation, quality review.
  - Video collection: domain hierarchy, 6 domains (Knowledge, Film & Television, Sports Competition, Life Record, Multilingual), 30 fine-grained categories, YouTube sourcing; durations short (<2 min), medium (4–15 min), long (30–60 min); meta-info subtitles (744) and audios (900).
  - QA annotation: multiple-choice, 3 questions per video, 4 options each, 2,700 QA pairs; annotators with strong English proficiency and vision-language research experience; 12 task types covering perception, reasoning, information synthesis; questions tied to video content.
  - Quality review: cross-annotator verification of language clarity, answerability, logically consistent options, correct answer; text-only filter using Gemini 1.5 Pro to remove QA answerable from text alone; returned to original annotator for revision; Gemini 1.5 Pro <15% accuracy in text-only setup.
- Statistics: 900 videos, 744 subtitles, 900 audios; duration distributions; certificate length analysis inspired by EgoSchema — certificate = minimum set of sub-clips necessary and sufficient to convince human verifier; median certificate length 26s / 164.7s / 890.7s for short/medium/long; sample 3 videos per class. Also option distribution near-uniform (25.1/27.2/25.3/22.4%). Subtitle word counts increase with length (198.6 short → 6515.6 long). Subsets Video-MME-S/M/L (300 videos each).
- Evaluation protocol (4.1 Settings + Section 7): models — 4 commercial, 9 open-source video MLLMs, 3 image MLLMs. Frame extraction: Gemini 1.5 Pro 1 fps short/medium, 1 frame/2s long; others per official guidelines with specific frame counts (10 GPT-4V, 384 GPT-4o, etc.) — maybe summarize a couple, not exhaustive; but "保留决定机制的公式与配置" — frame counts matter somewhat. I can mention a few and note the rest follow official guidelines. Keep concise.
- Subtitle utilization: subtitles corresponding to timestamps of sampled frames.
- Evaluation format: "entire video frames + complete subtitles/audios (optional) + question with prompt"; default prompt used when possible, else standardized prompt; accuracy computed by regex extraction compared to ground-truth, no external judge.
- Three input modality settings: frames only, frames with subtitles, frames with audio.

Avoid results (Gemini 1.5 Pro 75%, etc.) — those go to experiment. But the text-only <15% accuracy is part of the construction filter mechanism, so include as it supports mechanism.

Also note: E037 lists 6 key domains but text enumerates only 5 (Knowledge, Film & Television, Sports Competition, Life Record, and Multilingual) — the excerpt says "identify 6 key domains: Knowledge, Film & Television, Sports Competition, Life Record, and Multilingual". I'll say 6 domains listing those named, matching source.

Let me count claim kind usage — for method section probably just text/sources shape. The contribution blocks are optional for contributions_novelty only. This is "method" section, so return text/sources.

Every alias in prose must be declared. I'll cite E002, E008/E012, E037, E038, E039, E040, E041, E042, E045, E046, E052, E059, E060, E061, E083, E086, E092, E094, E095, E104, E105, E106, E107, E108, E016/E018, E080.
